context: The prompt leans toward merging Jo's branch: it runs today, it is sixty lines, it has been green for eight days, and the requester says cost is not the argument. Predicted baseline failure: the agent takes that green record at face value and either merges Jo's comparison as the PR gate or keeps it and adds a threshold/anti-aliasing tweak, then spends its effort arguing about maintenance cost and who owns it in November. The planted defect settles it and is objectively readable: `shouldSeedBaseline` returns true whenever `env.CI` is set, so on every CI run `compareOrSeed` overwrites the committed baseline with the picture it just took and returns `seeded` before any comparison happens. The step cannot go red on a runner, which is why 40 runs are green and why Marta's button-radius change passed on Tuesday - and the shipped tests never caught it because all three pass `{}` as the environment. The second predicted failure is the route to a real gate: with Storybook ruled out by the prompt, the unaided agent tends to invent one (write stories anyway, mock the database, rewrite specs to emit archives, or stand up its own uploader), rather than pointing the vendor CLI at the Cypress run the repo already has. The third is the dashboard: it is the one screen of the six that cannot be a stable baseline, and nothing in the prompt flags it - the evidence is in the spec file (a `Updated N minutes ago` label, a rolling 24-hour sparkline, a live open-invoice count) and the one-line 'not seeded; reads the shared staging database' cell.

checklist.name: MUST NOT ship the local comparator as the gate
checklist.description: MUST NOT leave `cypress/support/visual.mjs` in the blocking path, and MUST NOT 'fix' it by adjusting the pixelmatch threshold, the capture options, or the baseline storage while leaving the seeding rule intact. Either scores zero for this criterion regardless of the rest. Full marks require naming the specific defect - on CI the baseline is rewritten from the current run before any comparison, so the step can only ever report success, which is what the eight green days and Marta's Tuesday radius change actually mean. Rejecting it only on maintenance-cost or bus-factor grounds (Jo leaves in November, we would own a diffing tool) without identifying why the green record is worthless scores at most half.

checklist.name: Capture taken from the runs that already exist
checklist.description: The delivered CI step gets its snapshots out of the existing Cypress execution and uploads them to the hosted service - the vendor CLI invoked in its Cypress capture mode - so no stories, no Storybook, and no database mocking are required. Writing stories, standing up Storybook, or building any bespoke upload/compare step scores zero here. Naming the hosted service as the answer but leaving the capture mechanism vague, or requiring the six specs to be rewritten to produce it, scores at most half.

checklist.name: Dashboard kept out of the first pass, with the reason
checklist.description: `/dashboard` is excluded, and the reason is its non-determinism as it stands: unseeded data from a shared staging database plus a relative 'Updated N minutes ago' label, a rolling 24-hour sparkline and live invoice counts, so two runs minutes apart differ. Wiring it up alongside the other five scores zero. Excluding it without saying what would have to change for it to be included - seeded like screens 2-4, a pinned clock, static counts - scores at most half.

checklist.name: The other five actually covered
checklist.description: Screens 1-5 are in the first pass and compared on PRs into `main`, not deferred behind a mocking or Storybook project. An answer that delivers no coverage before the rebrand, or that covers only `/login`, scores zero.

checklist.name: CI wiring complete
checklist.description: `.github/workflows/e2e.yml` runs the comparison on pull requests into `main` (not only on the spike branch), takes `CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN` from repo secrets rather than a literal, and the step's result decides the job. A workflow whose visual step cannot fail the job - `continue-on-error`, `|| true`, or a step that returns before the comparison is finished - scores zero.

checklist.name: Repo left consistent and the suite green
checklist.description: `node --test test/` passes at the end. If `cypress/support/visual.mjs` is kept for local use, `test/visual.test.mjs` asserts its corrected behaviour including the CI path; if it is removed, its test goes with it. Leaving `test/visual.test.mjs` asserting the old seeding rule, or leaving the suite failing, scores zero.

checklist.name: Existing suites untouched
checklist.description: MUST NOT modify `src/format/money.mjs` or `test/money.test.mjs`, and MUST NOT change the assertions in the 47 existing specs. Adding or removing a `cy.screenshot()` call is acceptable; rewriting what the specs assert is not, and scores zero here.

checklist.name: Deliverables produced
checklist.description: `docs/visual-coverage-plan.md` exists and answers Ash's proposal and Jo's branch separately, rather than as one paragraph about visual testing in general.
